newsitem.title: USA: Dow off highs, NYSE lifts curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow off highs, NYSE lifts curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chips relinquished most of their session gains in late afternoon on Thursday, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to lift program trading curbs.

In choppy late trading, the Dow slipped to 7859, up 17 points, triggering a lifting of index-arbitrage curbs at 1534 EDT/1934 GMT. Within minutes, the Dow rebounded to stand at 7878, up about 36 points, but well off its session high 7913.
Breadth remained decidedly positive, with advancing issues holding a roughly seven-to-four advantage on the NYSE.
